OPTIC Ph3: 83% proptosis response vs. 10% placebo at Wk24 (treatment policy — regardless of concomitant steroids). 28B Amgen acquisition Oct 2023. Defines TED market ceiling. Hearing loss 30%, IV Q3W×8 course. ~40% relapse within 12–18 months post-treatment — maintenance need. Next-gen must show cleaner safety and SC administration to displace.

Anti-CD19 B-cell depleter. Approved in NMOSD (different mechanism). EQUAL TED trial ongoing. Treatment policy expected. Logic: eliminate TRAb-producing cells. Different from receptor blockade — complementary mechanism. If positive, creates two validated approaches (receptor blockade + B-cell depletion) each appropriate for different patient subsets.

Anti-CD40 mAb. Phase 2 in Graves' hyperthyroidism and TED. Upstream mechanism: blocks B-T cell costimulation, reducing TRAb production. Novartis entering TED space validates the market attractiveness post-Amgen $28B acquisition. Estimand TBD.

Oral small molecule IGF-1R inhibitor. OPTIC Ph3. First oral option in TED if approved. IGF-1R only — does not address TSHR co-activation. Differentiation: oral convenience vs. IV/SC biologics. Validates IGF-1R druggability across multiple formats.
